Question: As a Dungeon Master, how do you collect player initiative scores at your table? Asking each player individually? Letting the player shout out numbers? Some digital system?
Answer: My group’s Discord server has a dedicated text channel for initiative tracking. We roll with the dice bot and then our server admin usually tallies it all up and posts it. When I run, I usually use an Excel spreadsheet. For example: You can just select the cells you want and copy-paste them into Discord and it will automatically post them as an image. Doing it this way, I can sort them in initiative order, and also keep track of HP and take notes on things like status effects.

Question: What’s the best illusion trap you’ve ever made/encountered?
Answer: My paladin character in War for the Crown, Fiorina Mazzanti, is a single mom. Art commissioned by me from 雌鹿 During the events of book 1, she’d left her daughter Violetta at the temple she was staying at under a cover identity. Unfortunately, the bad guys penetrated her cover, and during the coup d’etat against the Taldan Imperial Senate, they raided the temple and took Violetta hostage. We tracked the bad guys back to our patron Lady Martella Lotheed’s no-longer-safe safehouse, and while doing the dungeon crawl, Fiorina thought she heard Violetta calling for her and took off running, finally finding her unguarded in a dining hall. Out of character, I was pretty sure this was a trap of some kind. However, this was a kind of thing where I thought it was likely that Fia’s instincts as a mom would override her good sense, so I groaned OOC and said that Fia went right for her. Obviously, it was some kind of fiendish beastie in Violetta’s form, which got a free attack in against my flat-footed ass. The real Violetta was fine, by the way. We found her being held prisoner by the bad guys along with Lady Martella. I had statted Violetta as a young human aristocrat 1, so Fia gave her a spare weapon and told her to stay behind her while she cut her way to Martella. Violetta ended up scoring the killing blow against one of the bad guys herself!
